skills.name: Happy New Year!
skills.description: Cherina throws water around. Good effects on surrounding allies.  *Critical Rate +30% (10 sec) *Critical Damage +250% (10 sec)

skills.name: Good Luck Hydro Cannon
skills.description: Cherina blasts enemies with a water beam. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Changes Fire elemental enemies to None (7 sec) *ATK per sec x 400% Area Damage (7 sec) *ATK x 3000% Area Damage

abilities.name: Gas Mask
abilities.description: Rangers with this Ability won't take damage in advent stages  with the Poison Gas obstacle effect.

abilities.name: Ally Clone
abilities.description: Has a set chance of summoning 1 allied team Ranger when Rangers deploy.　  - Flyer and Air Ambush Rangers are not eligible to be summoned in this way.  - The Abilities of allied Rangers summoned by this Ability won't activate. - Summoned Rangers won't consume any Mineral and will have no effects on redeploy times.
